## df74e338b4f5

**Classification: suspected shortcut, reproduced on a finite generator sample; plus reproduced contract defects.**

Assigned generator SHA-256: `374fbf52b1f9c4606bffd2541c27a15c3c703285c23b8b77919261c705853d00`. Executed canonical rule hash: `3ba84d8589ae`.

### What was checked

I read the generator, documented invariants, canonical examples, and selected Racket rule; ran standalone lint; generated 64 default instances with seed `audit-default-df-v1`, sample indices 0–63; obtained all 64 authority outputs through `arcpuzzles apply`; and tested a hand-built inset-frame case against the same authority. The target source was not edited.

### Shortcut

The generator always starts its concentric frame stack on the canvas boundary and packs the default 3–4 requested frames as deeply as the 11–14 default dimensions permit. The wrong rival `canvas_edge_distance_depth` never detects frames: for each marker it writes `ceil(min-distance-to-canvas-edge / 2)`. That rival matched **64/64** sampled generator outputs (`checks/audit/df74e338b4f5/rival-probe.json`).

A lawful 15×15 counterexample places three concentric color-9 frames at offsets 1, 3, and 5, with a marker at the center. The authority counts three containing frames and outputs color 3; the rival uses canvas distance 7 and outputs color 4. Exact input, Racket output, rival output, hashes, and command are in `checks/audit/df74e338b4f5/counterexample.json`; the raw supported apply report is `checks/audit/df74e338b4f5/racket.json`.

**Validator/domain status.** This target defines no `self_check`, so a target-validator pass is unavailable. The input satisfies the written generator invariants: three concentric rectangular 9-frames, one blank-cell ring between frames, and a non-{0,9} marker in a valid blank cell. The Racket output is reported valid. This is therefore a domain-supported suspected shortcut, not a claim that every possible training draw is wrong.

### Reproduced contract defects

Standalone lint also fails because `RULE_HASH` is missing and no top-level `self_check` exists (`checks/audit/df74e338b4f5/lint/checks/df74e338b4f5_before_lint.log`). No fix was made because this is an audit-only target.

triage.reason: Retain reviewer-reported findings and reproducers on both random audit targets; their source is unchanged.
